verdict.rationale: Stripe documents registering smart readers to an account by registration code, serial number, or order number. Serial registration can happen right after unboxing, without physical access to the reader, and a reader must be registered to a location before it can take payments. Readers can be ordered, registered, configured, and monitored from the Dashboard, and there are no-code and Tap to Pay paths for accepting payments quickly. Missing for 10: explicit docs on pairing a reader with a POS app (e.g. Bluetooth or SDK connect flow), independent or hands-on corroboration that setup to first payment really takes minutes.
